caption: Creating a form: a domain has to be entered, and the Status switch starts on ON; we used a test domain and switched the form off.
Creating a custom field: the dialog notes that Property Type and Key cannot be edited later.
Our test form saved as a DRAFT on example.com, with 0 visitors, views and conversions.
The form's actions menu offers Edit design, Change name, Change domain and Delete, but no preview that saves a test submission.
Leads > Contacts on the free plan shows an Upgrade now screen instead of a contacts list.
Billing on the free plan: current plan Free with 0 of 1,000 visitors used; the plan cards open on yearly billing, with Basic at $20 a month billed as $240 a year.
Switching to Basic monthly: $25 a month with empty card fields and no tax or total shown before the card details; we entered nothing.
Plan features on the popup ladder: Free has 1,000 visitors a month and one domain, with Unbranded crossed out, so Poptin branding stays on.
